title: Green Guardians and Horizon Monitoring at Nemo Reef
summary: This community involves entities such as Green Guardians and Horizon engaged in monitoring unauthorized activities at Nemo Reef. The presence of such equipment is supported by data [Data: Event_Communication_610; Event_Monitoring_608].

The Green Guardians have been proactive in documenting evidence of these activities, as reflected in assessments aimed at recording findings about deep-sea operations.
